commands: set -u; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '=== CURRENT CANDIDATES ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usb* /dev/tty.usb* 2>/dev/null || true; echo; for p in /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/cu.usbserial* /dev/cu.SLAB_USBtoUART* /dev/cu.wchusbserial*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; echo "=== PROBE $p ==="; python -m esptool --port "$p" --baud 115200 chip_id 2>&1 || true; echo "=== SECURITY $p ==="; python -m esptool --port "$p" --baud 115200 get_security_info 2>&1 || true; done
